$comment: Re-anchoring on shadcn/ui: the upstream release, the re-tokenization table and the classification of the components. Read by scripts/retokenize-codemod.ts; the process is in CONTRIBUTING.md.

focus-visible:ring-1.reason: A 1px focus ring becomes 2px (space.focus-ring-width). Every focusable element draws one ring width from one token, and ring-1 is a raw pixel width, which is forbidden.

focus-visible:ring-3.reason: A 3px focus ring becomes 2px (space.focus-ring-width), the middle ground between the original 3px, unusually thick, and the 1px used most in the code, too thin to stay visible.

focus-visible:ring-[3px].reason: A 3px focus ring becomes 2px (space.focus-ring-width): the token is a middle ground between the original 3px, unusually thick, and a 1px ring too thin to stay visible.

focus-within:ring-1.reason: A 1px ring shown when a descendant has focus becomes 2px (space.focus-ring-width), as FOCUS_RING_WITHIN draws it. Every focus indicator shares one width token; ring-1 is a raw pixel width.

aria-invalid:ring-1.reason: The 1px ring an invalid control showed at all times is removed: aria-invalid sets the border and ring color only, and the 2px ring appears with focus. A ring always on hides keyboard focus (WCAG 2.4.7).

aria-invalid:ring-3.reason: The 3px ring an invalid radio showed at all times is removed: aria-invalid sets the border and ring color only, and the 2px ring appears with focus. A ring always on hides keyboard focus (WCAG 2.4.7).

has-aria-invalid:ring-1.reason: A group holding invalid controls keeps its ring, 2px (space.focus-ring-width) instead of 1px. Only a group may keep a ring on has-aria-invalid, because focus still shows on the control inside it.

has-[[data-slot][aria-invalid=true]]:rin.reason: InputGroup keeps its ring while a control inside is invalid, 2px (space.focus-ring-width) instead of 1px. A wrapper of several controls may keep it, because focus shows on the control inside.

has-[[data-slot=input-group-control]:foc.reason: The ring InputGroup draws when its control has focus-visible goes from 1px to 2px (space.focus-ring-width). The wrapper takes over the control's indicator, so it draws the shared focus ring width.

has-[>input:focus-visible]:ring-1.reason: The ring a Questionnaire choice draws when its input has focus-visible goes from 1px to 2px (space.focus-ring-width), the shared focus ring width. ring-1 is a raw pixel width.

has-[>[data-slot=field]]:has-[:focus-vis.reason: The ring a Field draws when a control inside has focus-visible goes from 1px to 2px (space.focus-ring-width), the shared focus ring width. ring-1 is a raw pixel width.

data-[active=true]:ring-1.reason: The ring of the active InputOTP slot goes from 1px to 2px (space.focus-ring-width). The linter checks data-[active=true] like a focus state, so it uses the shared focus ring width.

[button,a]:focus-visible:ring-1.reason: The ring of a focused Bubble button or link goes from 1px to 2px (space.focus-ring-width), the shared focus ring width. ring-1 is a raw pixel width.

group-data-[focused=true]/day:ring-[3px].reason: The ring of a focused Calendar day goes from 3px to 2px (space.focus-ring-width). The linter checks data-[focused=true] like a focus state, so it uses the shared focus ring width.

focus-visible:outline-1.reason: A 1px focus outline is replaced by the border color change that goes with the 2px ring (border-ring). outline-1 is a raw pixel outline width, rejected by tokens:lint-values; Tabs keeps a token-width outline instead.

hover:bg-[color-mix(in_oklch,var(--secon.reason: Hover on a secondary Button mixes 5% foreground into secondary in oklch; it becomes secondary at 80% alpha, the same /80 hover as Badge. The color-mix arbitrary value is dropped.

[&>[data-slot=bubble-content]:is(button,.reason: Hover on a secondary Bubble mixes 5% foreground into secondary in oklch; it becomes secondary at 80% alpha. The color-mix arbitrary value is dropped.
Hover on a muted Bubble mixes 5% foreground into muted in oklch; it becomes muted at 80% alpha. The color-mix arbitrary value is dropped.

*:data-[slot=bubble-content]:bg-[oklch(f.reason: The tinted Bubble background, a relative oklch color (lightness 0.93, chroma times 0.4) derived from primary, becomes primary at 10% alpha. Relative-color arbitrary values are replaced by token alphas.

dark:*:data-[slot=bubble-content]:bg-[ok.reason: The tinted Bubble background in dark mode, a relative oklch color (lightness 0.3) derived from primary, becomes primary at 20% alpha. Relative-color arbitrary values are replaced by token alphas.

[&>[data-slot=bubble-content]:is(button,.reason: Hover on a tinted Bubble button or link, a relative oklch color (lightness 0.88) derived from primary, becomes primary at 20% alpha. Relative-color arbitrary values are replaced by token alphas.

dark:[&>[data-slot=bubble-content]:is(bu.reason: Dark-mode hover on a tinted Bubble button or link, a relative oklch color (lightness 0.35) derived from primary, becomes primary at 30% alpha. Relative-color arbitrary values are replaced by token alphas.

[&>span]:opacity-70.reason: A secondary line at 70% opacity (it faded the whole node) becomes text color at 70% alpha (text-current/70), which leaves the rest of the node untouched. Opacity is reserved for binary states.

gap-[--spacing(var(--gap))].reason: gap-[--spacing(n)] no longer compiles (the --spacing() function is removed), so it draws nothing. The calc form multiplies the runtime --spacing (4px) by the spacing prop, as before.

max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)].reason: DialogContent's max width, the viewport minus 2rem (32px), becomes the viewport minus space.component.lg (24px). The gutter is a token, not a raw rem.

**:data-[slot=navigation-menu-link]:focu.reason: The ring reset on every NavigationMenu link under focus is removed, so a focused link keeps its own focus ring. A reset under **: hides the indicator of other nodes.
The outline-none reset on every NavigationMenu link under focus is removed, so a focused link keeps its own focus ring. A reset under **: hides the indicator of other nodes.

outline-none.reason: outline-none (outline-style none) becomes outline-hidden, which also keeps a transparent 2px outline in forced-colors mode. outline-none would leave no focus indicator there, where box-shadow rings are not painted.

w-[100px].reason: The Drawer handle is 96px (w-24) instead of 100px. A raw pixel width is replaced by the nearest step of the locked spacing scale.

rounded-[2px].reason: A 2px radius becomes rounded-xs, 4px (radius.xs). Chart legend swatches use a radius token, not an arbitrary value.

duration-400.reason: A 400ms duration becomes duration-slow, 300ms (motion.duration.slow). Durations come from the motion tokens, never hard-coded values.

ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)].reason: The ease-out-quint curve (0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) becomes the ease-out token, cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) (motion.easing.out). Easings come from the motion tokens, never hard-coded curves.

ease-[cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1)].reason: The curve (0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) becomes the ease-out token, cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) (motion.easing.out). Easings come from the motion tokens, never hard-coded curves.

ease-[cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.84,0)].reason: The curve (0.7, 0, 0.84, 0) becomes the ease-in token, cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 1, 1) (motion.easing.in), used for leaving the screen. Easings come from the motion tokens, never hard-coded curves.

shadow.reason: A bare shadow, which the elevation scale does not define (xs, sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl, inner), draws nothing here. It becomes shadow-sm (elevation.sm), the same two-layer shadow as Tailwind's default shadow.

origin-top-center.reason: origin-top-center is not a Tailwind utility and draws nothing; it becomes origin-top, which sets the transform origin to top center. Whether upstream meant this is not recorded.

scrollbar-none.reason: scrollbar-none becomes no-scrollbar, the utility of shadcn/tailwind.css, which also hides the scrollbar in WebKit (::-webkit-scrollbar) and legacy Edge.

scrollbar-thin.reason: scrollbar-thin (thin scrollbar width) is dropped, so MessageScroller's viewport keeps the default scrollbar. It was removed as a utility missing from the stack then; the installed Tailwind now compiles it.

scrollbar-gutter-stable.reason: scrollbar-gutter-stable (reserved scrollbar gutter) is dropped, so the MessageScroller viewport's layout can shift when its scrollbar appears. It was removed as a utility missing from the stack then; Tailwind now compiles it.

scrollbar-thumb-transparent.reason: scrollbar-thumb-transparent (transparent scrollbar thumb while autoscrolling) is dropped. Dropped with the other scrollbar utilities; the installed Tailwind now compiles it.

scrollbar-track-transparent.reason: scrollbar-track-transparent (transparent scrollbar track while autoscrolling) is dropped. Dropped with the other scrollbar utilities; the installed Tailwind now compiles it.

py-[calc(--spacing(0.8))].reason: py-[calc(--spacing(0.8))] (3.2px) draws nothing, as --spacing() no longer compiles; it becomes py-1 (4px), a step of the locked spacing scale.

translate-y-[--spacing(0.45)].reason: translate-y-[--spacing(0.45)] (1.8px) draws nothing, as --spacing() no longer compiles; it becomes translate-y-0.5 (2px), a step of the locked spacing scale.

min-w-[14ch].reason: A minimum width of 14ch becomes min-w-28 (112px). A font-relative width becomes a step of the locked spacing scale.

text-[0.625rem].reason: Text of 0.625rem (10px) becomes text-xs, 12px with a 1.33334 line height. The type scale has no step under 12px.

text-[0.8rem].reason: Text of 0.8rem (12.8px) becomes text-xs, 12px with a 1.33334 line height. The type scale has no arbitrary sizes.

transition-[color,box-shadow,background-.reason: A transition on color, box-shadow and background-color becomes transition-colors, which animates the color properties but not box-shadow. The design system's Input and Textarea use it; no reason is recorded.

grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto_auto].reason: minmax(0, 1fr) becomes 1fr for the first column of the Questionnaire actions grid, so the column can no longer shrink below its content width. No reason is recorded.

p-[3px].reason: A 3px padding becomes p-1 (4px). An arbitrary pixel value becomes a step of the locked spacing scale.

bottom-[-5px].reason: An offset of -5px becomes -bottom-1 (-4px). An arbitrary pixel offset becomes a step of the locked spacing scale (the scale also has a 5px step, 1.25).

ml-[-0.3rem].reason: A margin of -0.3rem (-4.8px) becomes -ml-1 (-4px). An arbitrary rem value becomes a step of the locked spacing scale.

mr-[-0.3rem].reason: A margin of -0.3rem (-4.8px) becomes -mr-1 (-4px). An arbitrary rem value becomes a step of the locked spacing scale.

ml-[-0.15rem].reason: A margin of -0.15rem (-2.4px) becomes -ml-0.5 (-2px). An arbitrary rem value becomes a step of the locked spacing scale.

mr-[-0.15rem].reason: A margin of -0.15rem (-2.4px) becomes -mr-0.5 (-2px). An arbitrary rem value becomes a step of the locked spacing scale.

ring-[3px].reason: A 3px ring becomes 2px (space.focus-ring-width), the middle ground between the original 3px, unusually thick, and a 1px ring too thin to stay visible. ring-[3px] is a raw pixel width.

var(--radius).reason: The Sonner toast radius var(--radius), which is radius.lg (10px), becomes var(--radius-md), radius.md (8px). Sonner's spec lists radius.md for it; the reason for 8px over 10px is not recorded.

z-50.reason: z-50 is 50; z-popover is 1500, above z-modal (1400), so a popover opened from a dialog stays above it. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-50 is 50; z-popover is 1500, above z-modal (1400), so a hover card opened from a dialog stays above it. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-50 is 50; z-popover is 1500, above z-modal (1400), so a menu opened from a dialog stays above it. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-50 is 50; z-popover is 1500, above z-modal (1400), so a context menu opened from a dialog stays above it. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-50 is 50; z-popover is 1500, above z-modal (1400), so a menu bar menu opened from a dialog stays above it. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-50 is 50; z-popover is 1500, above z-modal (1400), so a combobox list opened from a dialog stays above it. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.

opacity-50.reason: A combobox chip's remove button faded to 50% opacity; it is now text-muted-foreground (a color, not an opacity). Opacity is reserved for binary states.

hover:opacity-100.reason: The chip remove button no longer fades from 50% to 100% opacity on hover: its color is the static text-muted-foreground, and the hover step is dropped.

z-50.reason: z-50 is 50; z-popover is 1500, above z-modal (1400), so a navigation menu opened from a dialog stays above it. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-50 is 50; z-modal is 1400. Dialog layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-50 is 50; z-modal is 1400. Alert dialog layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-50 is 50; z-modal is 1400. Sheet layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-50 is 50; z-modal is 1400. Drawer layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-50 is 50; z-tooltip is 1700, the highest layer, so a tooltip stays above dialogs and popovers. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-50 is 50; z-popover is 1500, above z-modal (1400), so a select list opened from a dialog stays above it. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.

z-10.reason: z-10 is 10; z-dropdown is 1000. The select's scroll buttons, a local ordering, now sit on a global layer. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-10 is 10; z-dropdown is 1000. An avatar's badge, a local ordering, now sits on a global layer. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-10 is 10; z-dropdown is 1000. A focused button of a group, a local ordering, now sits on a global layer. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-10 is 10; z-dropdown is 1000. A focused calendar day, a local ordering, now sits on a global layer. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-10 is 10; z-dropdown is 1000. The active OTP slot, a local ordering, now sits on a global layer. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-10 is 10; z-dropdown is 1000. A focused toggle of a group, a local ordering, now sits on a global layer. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.
z-10 is 10; z-dropdown is 1000. The resizable handle grip, a local ordering, now sits on a global layer. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.

focus-visible:ring-ring.reason: The resizable handle's focus indicator, a full-color 1px ring, becomes the shared focus ring: border-ring plus a 2px ring at 50% alpha (ring-ring/50). Every focusable element draws that ring.

z-10.reason: z-10 is 10; z-fixed is 1200 for the fixed sidebar container. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.

z-20.reason: z-20 is 20; z-sticky is 1100 for the sidebar rail. Layers come from the zindex tokens, never hard-coded numbers.

shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--sidebar-border)].reason: The floating Sidebar's outline, a raw 1px box-shadow, becomes a ring whose width reads border-width.default (1px) and whose color is sidebar-border. Same 1px; changing the token now moves surface outlines too.

hover:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--sidebar-ac.reason: On the outline Sidebar button, the hover outline (a raw 1px box-shadow) becomes hover:ring-sidebar-accent. Only the color changes on hover; the width is the base ring, border-width.default (1px).

md:after:hidden.reason: The hit area of a sidebar action button is no longer hidden from md up: after:-inset-0.5 extends it 2px past the button, so the target is 24x24 (WCAG 2.5.8, size.target.min).

data-[size=md]:text-xs.reason: data-size="md" becomes data-size="default" on SidebarMenuSubButton: the size scale names the base size default and has no md. The text size is unchanged (text-xs).

hover:ring-1.reason: The ring on a hovered Slider thumb goes from 1px to 2px (space.focus-ring-width). ring-1 is a raw pixel width, forbidden; the Slider spec lists the focus ring token for hover and active.

active:ring-1.reason: The ring on a Slider thumb while dragging goes from 1px to 2px (space.focus-ring-width). ring-1 is a raw pixel width, forbidden; the Slider spec lists the focus ring token for hover and active.

h-[18.4px].reason: The default Switch track is 20px high (h-5) instead of 18.4px. A raw pixel height becomes a step of the locked spacing scale.

opacity-50.reason: The Command search icon faded to 50% opacity; it is now text-muted-foreground (a color, not an opacity). Opacity is reserved for binary states.

w-30.reason: A vertical attachment with content is 128px wide (w-32) instead of 120px (w-30, which the spacing scale lacks and which draws nothing here).

opacity-60.reason: An attachment image while uploading or processing is 60% opaque; it is now grayscale, because opacity is reserved for binary states. A filter desaturates it instead of fading it.

opacity-100.reason: The attachment image once done or idle is fully opaque (opacity-100); it is now grayscale-0, the counterpart of grayscale while uploading. Opacity is reserved for binary states.

text-destructive/80.reason: The error description of an attachment is destructive text at 80% alpha; it becomes full text-destructive, the token measured for contrast. The reason is not recorded.

gap-1.5.reason: The gap of the breadcrumb list is 6px both ways; it becomes 6px between items and 8px between wrapped rows (gap-x-1.5 gap-y-2), so rows are 8px apart and the target size spacing exception holds.

in-data-[slot=combobox-content]:focus-wi.reason: Never took effect: it compiles to a :where() selector of specificity (0,2,0), and the has-[[data-slot=input-group-control]:focus-visible] border rule it meant to cancel is (0,3,0). A search field in a popup draws the standard border, as every focusable element does (lib/focus.ts); the class is dropped so the source says so.

Never took effect, for the same reason as its border twin: the has-[[data-slot=input-group-control]:focus-visible] ring rule outranks it. A search field in a popup draws the standard 2px ring; the class is dropped so the source says so.

has-disabled:bg-input/50.reason: has-disabled matches any disabled descendant, so a disabled InputGroupButton (a Send button) dimmed the whole group and the enabled field in it (text at 3.51:1, WCAG 1.4.3). The group now mirrors its own field only, [data-slot=input-group-control].

has-disabled:opacity-50.reason: has-disabled matches any disabled descendant: a disabled InputGroupButton dimmed the whole group to 0.5 with the field enabled. The group now mirrors its own field only, [data-slot=input-group-control]; opacity-50 is opacity-disabled, as everywhere.

dark:has-disabled:bg-input/80.reason: Same selector as has-disabled:bg-input/50, in dark: the group takes the disabled background from its own field only, not from a disabled button.

placeholder:text-muted-foreground.reason: A <select> has no ::placeholder, so the class drew nothing and the "Choose a city" option read as a chosen value (text-foreground). The selected empty-value option is a select's placeholder: the select takes text-muted-foreground (color.text.subtle) while it is selected, as Select does with data-placeholder.

alert.reason: The success and warning variants (declared in shadcn.divergences): their colors, and the icon and description following the variant's color.

attachment.reason: The focus-within ring is FOCUS_RING_WITHIN, with its border color: every focus indicator of the design system has both.

badge.reason: The success and warning variants (declared in shadcn.divergences), and the destructive variant's focus border of FOCUS_RING_DESTRUCTIVE.

chart.reason: The chart surface is a tab stop (Recharts' accessibility layer) whose outline upstream hides, counting on the tooltip to mark focus. Recharts shows the tooltip on the first focus only and never without ChartTooltip (WCAG 2.4.7), so ChartContainer draws the ring and a 1px outline of border-ring while anything inside it is :focus-visible; has-focus-visible, not .recharts-surface, also covers a Pie layer and a Brush.

combobox.reason: ComboboxChipsInput's placeholder took Tailwind's default (currentColor at 50%, 3.70:1); it takes text-muted-foreground (color.text.subtle), as Input and ComboboxInput do.

command.reason: The input's InputGroup draws the focus ring (WCAG 2.4.7): upstream's input-group rule never matches the command-input slot.

heading.reason: No shadcn/ui item: a design-system component.

illustration.reason: No shadcn/ui item: a design-system component.

input-group.reason: An icon-only InputGroupButton is at least size.target.min wide (WCAG 2.5.8).

logo.reason: No shadcn/ui item: a design-system component.

menubar.reason: The menubar trigger draws FOCUS_RING: upstream shows no focus indicator on it (WCAG 2.4.7).

password-input.reason: No shadcn/ui item: a design-system component.

tabs.reason: TabsContent, a tab stop, draws FOCUS_RING (WCAG 2.4.7); upstream resets its outline and draws nothing.
